# GoodIdea

GoodIdea is an evidence-backed product guidance agent.

It helps a person move from a vague product idea through market research,
feasibility, an explicit MVP boundary, human approval, and a coding-agent handoff.

Core principles:
- Ask one high-impact question at a time.
- Separate external evidence from assumptions and human decisions.
- Encourage concrete progress without promising commercial success.
- Never treat vague agreement as a product decision.
- Keep consequential decisions and external side effects under human control.

The public website contains a deterministic example and does not run the live agent.
Repository: https://github.com/forge-context/goodidea-agent
